Title: VTES Draft Tournament in South Carolina

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
We'll be holding a V:TES draft tournament at Heroes and Dragons in
Columbia, SC in a few weeks (April 27, a Saturday, at 10:30).

There will be a VTES starter and 5 VTES boosters provided to each
player (for a $10 entry fee). Those cards will be drafted in Mixed
Draft format (vampires first via table draft, then library cards via
"booster" draft with 15-card groups for "boosters").

Come join us if you can. I should reasonably be able to accomodate up
to 30 players (probably a good 50% more than will be able to attend,
I'd guess).
